initialization.import_export_gate: All original typed tensors reconstructed bit-identically, original nonuniform index choices and BF16 scales unchanged; native forward on same causal rows before any update.

historical_reproduction.meaning: This is a new schedule, not run11 or Zmix reproduction.

matched_arms.common: Same initial model, source, seed49, causal row order, masks, batch exposure, optimizer update count, precision and computed penalty graph. Both compute size proxy; A multiplies by zero.

data.source: Full1000000000-byte enwik9 after original tagged ordering and lexical frontend
data.ppmd: Original3500MB pruned deployed PPMD; actual post-byte float16 priors captured and205-vocabulary projection authenticated
data.causality: Preserve article/OOV/131072-token resets and prior-row coordinates. Carry native decoder-available state through1024-token optimization chunks; detach carried differentiable state between chunks, never create an artificial decoder reset.
data.coverage: One complete pass over all actual valid neural prediction targets; N is measured eligible target count, not available rows.
data.batch: Accumulate1024-token causal chunks to32768 valid targets per optimizer update; final update uses remaining valid targets; no dropped remainder.
data.alignment_gate: Each capture shard has raw/transformed coordinate range, reset markers, predecessor-state identity, row count, map/prior hashes and bit-exact decompression witness.

schedule.epoch_definition: One complete eligible-target pass over full transformed corpus
schedule.updates: U=ceil(N/32768); same U and target exposures both arms
schedule.learning_rate: For update u=1..min(100,U),1e-5*u/min(100,U); remaining cosine from1e-5 to1e-6 over U-min(100,U) updates. If U<=100, warmup only.
schedule.selection: Only terminal checkpoint per arm; no validation-based early stopping or hyperparameter rescue.

precision.gemm: FP32 integer-domain dot products for original W4/W8/A8 operands, original row-then-token scaling; FP32 recurrence,norm and masters; BF16 stored scales. Actual diagnostic verified on gfx1151; native CPU forward remains authoritative.
precision.low_precision_simulation: Original nonuniform four-bit codebook indices and grid0.25, original BF16 row scales, small int8 tables, dynamic per-token max(abs(x),1e-12)/127 activation scales, ties-to-even int8 rounding/clamp[-128,127], original static Q/K/V quantizers.
precision.backward: Approximate whole-reference Jacobian is explicitly declared. No claim of exact native kernel derivative.

size_penalty.kind: New fully specified soft code histogram objective; not asserted to reproduce Zmix
size_penalty.classes: Tensor role with decimal layer-index runs replaced by #, paired with alphabet.
size_penalty.eight_bit: Same rule over integer levels[-127,127] for8-bit tables, no codebook grid.
size_penalty.counts: For class g, n_gj=sum_i p_ij; L_g=sum_j n_gj; f_gj=(n_gj+1)/(L_g+K_g).
size_penalty.B_hat_bits: -sum_g sum_j n_gj*log2(f_gj); metadata,raw float/codebook/scale costs outside proxy are measured separately.
size_penalty.objective_units: 2*ln(2)*B_hat_bits/N is paid two-copy nats per full-corpus valid target.
size_penalty.selection_authority: Produced native payload and actual packed model/stub/options. Soft entropy and training loss receive no score credit.

storage.policy: Sharding preserves total. Measure a lossless prior coding on position-matched deployed rows, verify decompression bitwise and record actual bytes and throughput. If capacity insufficient, stop before capture; no storage credit from a projection or shard count.
